message.ring_of_the_hundred_curses.custo: Your traded item is held at customs. Estimated delivery: %s days
Endure every curse and witness every hardship.
Trigger curse: All creatures become hostile towards you.
Trigger curse: Reduces the hunger restoration from food.
Trigger curse: Reduces the stack limit of items.
Trigger curse: Weapons can only be used when fully charged.
Trigger curse: Cannot use a shield in the off-hand.
Trigger curse: Suffocation effect occurs in many place.
Trigger curse: Cannot sleep in beds.
Trigger curse: Raw meat gives debuffs.
Trigger curse: Cannot mine hard blocks.
Trigger curse: Cannot run when light levels are too low.
Trigger curse: Water cannot be placed in the End.
Trigger curse: Chests cannot give high-level loot.
Trigger curse: Wearing equipment reduces movement speed.
Trigger curse: Deals less damage to enemies.
Trigger curse: Reduces experience point gain.
Trigger curse: Fall damage cannot be mitigated.
Trigger curse: Reduces armor and toughness given by armor.
Trigger curse: Maps and compasses become useless.
Trigger curse: Cannot use high-level enchantments.
Trigger curse: Reduces swimming speed, and drowning damage increases with depth.
Trigger curse: Respawn anchors charge with a random number of uses.
Trigger curse: Enchanting the same weapon repeatedly reduces its enchantment level.
Trigger curse: A trident with Loyalty has a chance to damage the player when returning.
Trigger curse: Opening loot chests in Pillager Outposts or Villages spawns Pillagers and Villagers.
Trigger curse: Each time you take damage, you receive additional damage based on a percentage of your maximum health.
Trigger curse: After killing a mob, there is a chance to spawn the same mob in place.
Trigger curse: Attacks, placements, and crafting have a chance to fail.
Trigger curse: Negative effects are applied after respawning.
Trigger curse: The phantom will be refreshed every night, and the phantom will airdrop monsters.
Trigger curse: Villager trade prices are higher.
Trigger curse: Moving and jumping abilities are reduced when in high or low altitudes.
Trigger curse: Lower health also reduces attack power.
Trigger curse: Respawn with a portion of your health and hunger.
Trigger curse: You cannot naturally regenerate health.
Trigger curse: Shield durability drains when holding a shield.
Trigger curse: Instant healing effects you receive will be delayed.
Trigger curse: Each time you gain a positive buff, existing buffs shorten while debuffs are extended.
Trigger curse: Mobs' melee attacks can hit through blocks.
Trigger curse: The chance of fortune enchantment not triggering while mining is increased.
Trigger curse: Every time you throw an Ender Pearl, Endermites spawn to attack you.
Trigger curse: There is a chance to be teleported to a random location near the target when using a portal.
Trigger curse: The chance of fishing up junk is significantly increased.
Trigger curse: Fishing has a chance to catch something bad.
Trigger curse: Archery has a larger arrow deviation.
Trigger curse: Every time you die to a boss, the boss not only recovers full health but becomes stronger.
Trigger curse: Mining stone has a chance to spawn Silverfish.
Trigger curse: Reduces player's invincibility frames.
Trigger curse: Doubles the experience cost for the enchantment table.
Trigger curse: Slows movement speed in water.
Trigger curse: Sneaking no longer prevents falling off edges.
Trigger curse: Only armor with trims can be worn.
Trigger curse: Ender Eyes always break upon use.
Trigger curse: When the Ender Dragon breathes fire, a dragon breath area appears under the player's feet.
Trigger curse: Piglins may take gold without bartering.
Trigger curse: Player takes more damage while sneaking.
Trigger curse: Player cannot attack non-hostile creatures first.
Trigger curse: Eating has a delay, during which no actions can be performed.
Trigger curse: Crops now have a chance to drop dead bushes instead.
Trigger curse: All blocks in cold biomes apply ice physics.
Trigger curse: Plants can deal damage to the player.
Trigger curse: Swimming has a time limit; after which the player starts sinking.
Trigger curse: Overconsuming a single type of food reduces its hunger restoration.
Trigger curse: The more hostile mobs nearby, the more damage the player takes.
Trigger curse: Taking damage has a chance to cause continuous health loss.
Trigger curse: Having too low or too high saturation applies debuffs.
Trigger curse: The higher the health of a trading entity, the more expensive its trades.
Trigger curse: Introduces universal damage cap and ranged damage resistance.
Trigger curse: If the player was previously killed by a mob, encountering it again causes a debuff.
Trigger curse: The player's dropped items are calculated multiple times, taking the worst result.
Trigger curse: You cannot remove negative effects with milk.
Trigger curse: Significantly increases the chance of being struck by lightning.
Trigger curse: While in the Nether, being attacked will set you on fire.
Trigger curse: The lower your equipment’s durability, the less armor protection it provides.
Trigger curse: After completing a trade with a villager, there’s a chance the item you receive will be swapped for something else.
Trigger curse: The lower a weapon’s durability, the less damage it deals.
Trigger curse: Crafted items have a chance to spawn with reduced durability or in reduced quantity.
Trigger curse: When your inventory holds too many items, your movement speed is reduced and fall damage is increased.
Trigger curse: Portals become one-time use; they explode after being used.
Trigger curse: Each time you attack, there’s a chance your weapon’s attack power will decrease.
Trigger curse: Advanced villager trades require waiting several Minecraft days before the items become available.
Trigger curse: When fertilizing crops, there’s a chance their growth stage will regress—and the more fertilizer you apply, the higher the chance.
Trigger curse: There’s a chance to trample and break farmland when walking over tilled soil.
Trigger curse: You may occasionally see distant structures that aren’t actually there.
Trigger curse: Tools can only perform their designated function.
Trigger curse: When blocking damage with a shield, there’s a chance your shield will break.
Trigger curse: Food stored in your inventory for too long will spoil into rotten flesh.
Trigger curse: Using a healing item may cause you to be unable to heal again for a short time.
Trigger curse: You must alternate different attack methods to damage certain creatures.
Trigger curse: Placed torches and campfires must be manually lit.
Trigger curse: During rain, block friction is reduced, making surfaces slippery.
Trigger curse: Cooked meals have a chance to turn into mysterious stew that inflicts a debuff.
Trigger curse: You don’t always need a Sculk Shrieker to summon the Warden.
Trigger curse: The appearance of the ender dragon will play better and better remixes and add post-processing effects.
